brand_dna.category: Football head and neck protection - a patented collar that works with shoulder pads and helmets to reduce concussion and stinger risk.
brand_dna.core_belief: To tell the truth about concussions and protect players beyond what a helmet can, during the critical moments after impact when the head keeps moving.
proof_points: Patented deceleration design reduces brain impact forces by up to 30%
Independently biomechanically tested; worn by NFL and major college programs
Founded and invented by Jeff Chambers, Certified Athletic Trainer with 40+ years experience
Made in the USA; constructed from durable high-density polyethylene (HDPE) with a neoprene flange
